item.title: Driver killed in crash involving CTA bus in Heart of Chicago, police say
item.description: Chicago police are investigating a deadly crash involving a CTA bus on Sunday.

item.title: Pedestrian injured in Niles crash, police say
item.description: Niles police are investigating a crash involving a pedestrian on Sunday.

item.title: US Olympians speaking up about politics at home face online backlash - including from Trump
item.description: Reporters on Friday asked U.S. athletes at a news conference how they feel representing the country during the Trump administration's heighted immigration enforcement actions.

item.title: France's former culture minister resigns over Epstein-linked tax fraud investigation
item.description: Jack Lang is the highest-profile figure in France impacted by the release of Epstein files on Jan. 30 by the U.S. Department of Justice.

item.title: Bad Bunny brings Gaga, Martin to Super Bowl as Green Day, Puth play pregame
item.description: Stars have been front-and-center at Super Bowl 60, with Chris Pratt and Jon Bon Jovi introducing the teams, a series of soaring pre-game performances and a much-anticipated halftime show from Bad Bunny.

item.title: 'The Mandalorian and Grogu' first look debuts during Super Bowl
item.description: "The Mandalorian and Grogu" got a brief Big Game spot, airing during the first quarter of the Super Bowl.

item.title: Two Dixmoor water main breaks repaired, village officials say
item.description: Two water main breaks in Dixmoor have been repaired, village officials said on Sunday.

item.title: Seahawks ride their 'Dark Side' defense to a Super Bowl title, pounding the Patriots 29-13
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks have won the franchise's second Super Bowl, and defense was the driving force behind this championship.

item.title: Puerto Ricans gather in Humboldt Park to watch Bad Bunny's history-making Super Bowl halftime show
item.description: The artistic director for the Grant Park Music Festival made an appearance in the show, conducting a group of string players during Bad Bunny's "Monaco."

item.title: Person taken into custody after SWAT team responds to incident in Chicago's Wildwood neighborhood
item.description: One person was taken into custody after a SWAT team responded to an incident on Chicago's Far Northwest Side on Sunday morning, police said.
